newsitem.title: USA: China seen selling 300,000 tonnes or more corn.
newsitem.headline: China seen selling 300,000 tonnes or more corn.

text.p: China has sold at least 300,000 tonnes of corn recently, marking its return to the world market as an exporter, Gus Schumacher, head of the Agriculture Department's Foreign Agricultural Service, said Thursday.
"China is back in the corn market," Schumacher told an audience at a rural development seminar on Capitol Hill. He said China's export sales were "300,000 tonnes to start with, and maybe more."
China had a record large grain crop this season, and Schumacher said Beijing's interest in exports showed how attractively high grain prices had climbed.
"On the other hand, China is importing a lot of soyoil," he told reporters who inquired about trade with China.

Corn futures in Chicago were lower this morning on reports of the Chinese corn sales. China was reported to have sold 145,000 tonnes of corn to the Philippines, and another 50,000 tonnes to South Korea.
